title: What's the point of buying a touchscreen laptop when you could just get a tablet?

claims.claim: Apple, PROLED MacBook Pro adında ilk dokunmatik ekranlı Mac modelini duyurdu.

evidence.quote: Recently, Apple made headlines by announcing its first-ever touchscreen Mac, the PROLED MacBook Pro.

claims.claim: Apple'ın kurucu ortağı Steve Jobs, dokunmatik ekranlı dizüstü bilgisayarları ergonomik açıdan kötü olarak nitelendirmiştir.

evidence.quote: That's despite co-founder Steve Jobs famously decrying touchscreen laptops as "ergonomically terrible,"
That's despite co-founder Steve Jobs famously decrying touchscreen laptops as "ergonomically terrible," and launching an alternative in the form of 2010's iPad.

claims.claim: Dizüstü bilgisayarlar klavye ve izleme dörtgeni (trackpad) ile birlikte gelirken, tabletlerde bunlar genellikle ücretli ek aksesuarlardır.

evidence.quote: All laptops incorporate a keyboard and trackpad, whereas those are paid add-ons for tablets.

claims.claim: iPad modelleri genellikle tek bir bağlantı noktasına sahiptir.

evidence.quote: Tablets also tend to skimp on ports, with iPads being one of the worst offenders with their single port.

claims.claim: Tabletler genellikle Android veya iPadOS işletim sistemlerini kullanır.

evidence.quote: Most tablets run either Android or iPadOS, which are really locked-down smartphone operating systems at their core.

claims.claim: Dizüstü bilgisayarlar Windows, macOS veya Linux işletim sistemlerini çalıştırır.

evidence.quote: Laptops running Windows, macOS or Linux have fewer barriers, giving them access to more capable apps that sometimes have no real Android or iPad equivalent.
